patch.sql:
select
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    c.market_segment,
    c.account_balance,
    n.nation_name,
    r.region_name
from {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c
left join {{ ref('stg_nations') }} n on c.nation_key = n.nation_key
left join {{ ref('stg_regions') }} r on n.region_key = r.region_key
patch.explanation: The not_null_fct_orders_region_name test failed with 14744 nulls. fct_orders left joins dim_customers for region_name. dim_customers had many missing rows because its joins were wrong: it joined stg_customers to stg_nations on customer_key = nation_key and used an inner join to stg_regions, dropping most customers. Correcting to left joins on proper foreign keys restores region_name for all orders, fixing the test.
